title: Insulin Pump Compatibility Register for the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program
content:
The register below lists, for each insulin pump model, the CGM models of the Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program that pump accepts as its sensor source for automated insulin delivery. It is identical on every tier.

| Insulin pump model | CGM models the pump accepts |
|---|---|
| Tandem t:slim X2 | Dexcom G6, Dexcom G7, FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus |
| Tandem Mobi | Dexcom G6, Dexcom G7 |
| Beta Bionics iLet | Dexcom G6, Dexcom G7 |
| MiniMed 780G | None (empty list) |

An empty list means the pump uses its manufacturer's own sensors, supplied under the pump program.

## Reading the register

- Dexcom G6 and Dexcom G7 appear for every pump except the MiniMed 780G.
- FreeStyle Libre 2 Plus is accepted only by the Tandem t:slim X2.
- Neither Dexcom G7 15 Day nor FreeStyle Libre 3 Plus is accepted by any pump on the register.
